title: Equity compensation — Dev Raman
instructions: Dev Raman, an employee of Lattice Inc., had the equity compensation events below in 2025. Compute each amount.

exhibits.title: 2025 events
exhibits.content:
1. **Nonqualified options:** exercised 2,000 options at $15 when the stock was $40; sold the 2,000 shares in December 2025 at $42.
2. **Incentive stock options:** exercised 1,000 ISOs at $10 when the stock was $35; still holds the shares.
3. **Restricted stock units:** 500 RSUs vested and settled in shares when the stock was $40.
4. **Restricted stock:** received 1,000 restricted shares worth $5 each (paid nothing), vesting in 2028, and made a timely §83(b) election.

rows.label: Ordinary income from the NQSO exercise
Gain on the December sale of the NQSO shares
rows.explanation: (42 − 40) × 2,000 = **4,000**, short-term (basis is the $40 value at exercise).

rows.label: AMT adjustment from the ISO exercise
Total 2025 ordinary compensation income from these events
Ordinary income if Dev sells the ISO shares in March 2026 for $30
rows.explanation: A disqualifying disposition: ordinary income is the lesser of the spread (25,000) or the gain ((30 − 10) × 1,000 = 20,000): **20,000**.
